privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Advanced Digital Pathway Solutions ("ADP Solutions", "we") processes personal data when you visit adpway.com, contact us or work with us, in line with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and its implementing regulations.

p: Advanced Digital Pathway Solutions is a company registered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, headquartered in Riyadh. Commercial Registration: [ADD]. National Address: [ADD]. We are the controller of the personal data described in this policy.

Data you give us: your name, work e-mail, company, phone number, area of interest and message when you submit a form; your e-mail when you subscribe to updates; CV and contact details when you apply for a role.
Data collected automatically: technical data needed to run the site securely, such as IP address, browser type and pages visited. Analytics data is collected only if you accept analytics cookies.

list: To respond to your enquiry and provide the services you request
To send updates you have subscribed to
To evaluate job applications and partnership enquiries
To keep the site secure and prevent abuse
To meet our legal and regulatory obligations

p: We process personal data on the basis of your consent, which you can withdraw at any time; where needed to take steps at your request before entering a contract; and where required by law. Withdrawing consent does not affect processing carried out before withdrawal.

We aim to store and process personal data inside the Kingdom. Where a transfer outside the Kingdom is necessary, we carry it out only as permitted by the PDPL and its regulations, with appropriate safeguards. [CONFIRM hosting and e-mail providers and their locations]

We share personal data only with service providers that help us operate the site and our business (such as hosting and e-mail delivery), under contracts that require them to protect it, and with authorities where the law requires. We do not sell personal data.

We keep enquiries for up to [ADD] months after our last contact, newsletter data until you unsubscribe, and applicant data for up to [ADD] months unless you agree to a longer period. We then delete or anonymize it.

list: To be informed about how your data is processed
To access a copy of your personal data
To request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
To request destruction of data that is no longer needed
To withdraw consent at any time
To lodge a complaint with the competent authority (SDAIA)

p: We use technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss or misuse, including encryption in transit, access controls and logging.
To exercise your rights or ask about this policy, e-mail info@adpway.com or call +966 55 358 4835. [CONFIRM data protection contact]
We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of adpway.com, operated by Advanced Digital Pathway Solutions. By using the site you agree to them.

p: You may use the site for lawful purposes only. You must not attempt to disrupt it, gain unauthorized access to it or use it to send unsolicited messages.

Content is provided for general information about our company and services. Market figures are third-party estimates, and outcome figures describe typical results that vary by environment. Nothing on the site is a binding offer, legal advice or a guarantee of results.

The site, its design, text and our name and logo belong to ADP Solutions or are used under licence. You may not copy or reuse them without our written permission, except for personal, non-commercial reference.
The site may link to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their content or practices.
To the extent permitted by law, ADP Solutions is not liable for losses arising from use of the site or reliance on its content.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the competent courts in Riyadh.
We may update these terms. The date at the top shows when they were last changed.
Questions about these terms: info@adpway.com.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Cookies are small files stored by your browser. We use only the cookies needed to run this site, plus analytics cookies if, and only if, you accept them.

p: These are required for the site to work and cannot be switched off. They remember your language and your cookie choice.
If you accept them, these help us understand which pages are useful so we can improve the site. They are not set unless you choose "Accept analytics". [CONFIRM analytics provider]
You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie settings" link in the footer, or by clearing cookies in your browser.

consent.title: Cookies on this site
consent.body: We use necessary cookies to run this site. With your permission, we would also like to use analytics cookies to understand how it is used.
